paite: Vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm lai un hichi ahong ahi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Judah gam a Bethlehem mi khat Moab gam a teng tadih ding in amah leh azi leh atapate nih toh ahoh uhi.
heading: Moab Ah Elimelek Leh A-inkuan Apem Uh

paite: Huai mi min Elimelek ahi, azi min Naomi ahi, atapate nih min Mahlon leh Kilon ahi. Amau Judah gam a Bethlehem, Ephrath mi ahi uh. Moab gam ah ahoh ua, huai ah a-om nilouh uhi.
Elimelek, Naomi pasal asi a, amah leh atapate nih kia ahita uh.
Amau Moab gam numei zi in anei ua, akhat pen min Orpah ahi a, akhat pen min Ruth ahi. Huai ah kum sawm a-omta uhi.
Mahlon leh Kilon asi tuaktuak ua; huchi in huai numei atapate nih leh apasal in asihsanta uhi.
Huchi in amoute toh Moab gam a pan kik nawn ding in akisa uh; TOUPA'N nek ding pia a mite avehdan Moab gam a pan ana zak ziak in.
heading: Naomi Leh Ruth Jerusalem Kik Nawnna

paite: Huchi in a-omna a pan amoute nih toh apawt ua; Judah gam a kik nawn ding in apaita uhi.
Naomi in amou nihte kiang ah, "Na nute uh inn tuak ah pai nawnta un. Misi tung leh ka tung a siamtak a na hih bang un TOUPA'N na tung uah hih hen.
TOUPA'N na nih un na pasalte uh inn a khawlna na muhtheihna ding un hon hehpih hen," achi hi. Huchi in atawp a, aw suah hial in akapta uhi.
Amau akiang ah, "Pai kei ni ung, na chite kiang a na paina ah ka tel sam ding uh," achi uhi.
Naomi in, "Ka tanute aw, pai nawn zaw un. Bangziak a ka kiang a hong pai lai mahmah ding na hi ua? Na pasal ding uh tapate ka pai thei nawn dia hia?
Ka tanute aw, kisa unla, pai un; pasal nei ding in lah ka upa lota ngal a. Lametna ka nei chi mah leng, tuzan mahmah in leng pasal nei in tapate leng nei mah leng,
apichin tan ua om ding na hi ding uam? Pasal lou in na om nilouh ding ua hia? Hi tel lou e, ka tanute aw; nou ziak in ka lungkhamna a-uang semsem hi. TOUPA khut ka tung a tu ahita ve," achi hi.
A-aw uh suah in akap nawn leuleu uhi. Huchi in Orpah in api atawp a; Ruth in bel alen tinten hi.
Ama'n, "Ngai in, na moupihnu achite kiang leh apathian kiang ah apaikik nawnta. Nang leng na moupihnu delh inla, pai nawnta in," achi hi.
Ruth in, "Nang khen ding leh nang zui lou a kik nawn ding in hon kun ke'n. Na paina peuh ah ka pai dia; na giahna peuh ah ka giak dia; na chite ka chite ahi ding ua, na Pathian ka Pathian ahi ding.
Na sihna peuh ah ka si dia, huai ah na hon vui sam ding ahi. Nang leh kei sihna lou ngal thil dang in ahon khenleh TOUPA'N ahihhih in hon hih henla, hiai sang a thupizaw in leng," achi hi.
Huchi in akiang a pai atum tinten chih atheih in adaihsanta hi.
Huchi in Bethlehem tan apaikhawmta uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, Bethlehem atun un, akhozang un aling ua, numeite'n, "Hiai Naomi ahi maw?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Naomi hon chi kei un. Mara hon chi zaw un, Bangkim hihtheipa'n lah khatak in ahon hihta ngal a," achi hi.

"Buchingtak in ka pawt a, ToUPA'N avuak in hon pi nawn hi. TOUPA'N ka tung ah alungkimlouhna ahihlang a, Bangkim hihtheipa'n ahon hihgentheihdan theigige napi a bangziak a Naomi hon chi lailai na hi ua?" achi hi.
Huchi in Naomi ahong kik a, amounu Moab mi Ruth toh Moab gam a pan ahong kik uhi. Barli buhlak pat tung lai in Bethlehem atung uhi.
